verdict.rationale: Polar documents self-serve checkout surfaces: no-code Checkout Links configured in the dashboard, embedded checkout, and a Checkout Session API. It acts as Merchant of Record, so Stripe availability in the founder's country isn't required, and the free Starter plan needs no sales step. That makes a fast launch plausible, but the 'within a day of signing up' part is only implied by 'set up in minutes' language, and that phrase refers to migrating from an existing store. Missing for 10: documented account review/verification timeline before live payments, explicit live card-payment acceptance timing for new accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Configure once in the dashboard, share the URL anywhere (your website, social media, email, a button in your app), and Polar handles the rest.
As the Merchant of Record, Polar takes care of charging customers, so Stripe Payments doesn't need to be available in your country.
Get set up on Polar in minutes from an existing store
Payments & Billing with 6 lines of code.
